description: SPEL Limited is a Pakistani manufacturer of technology-intensive plastic products, established in 1982 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange in 2015. It makes automotive parts, FMCG and disposable packaging, and exports knobs, centre caps and similar components to more than seven countries.
headOffice: 127-S, Quaid-e-Azam Industrial Estate Township, Kot Lakhpat, Lahore, Pakistan
